description: Welcome to Team Gabex! We are a passionate crew stepping up to Be An Earth System Trend Detective! Our goal is to unlock the stories hidden in Earth science data and build tools that visualize environmental trends. We are currently looking for data analysts, UI/UX designers, and web developers to round out our squad. If you love solving mysteries, tracking planetary health, and building impactful tech, join us to create something amazing!
summary: Aether is an interactive, browser-based 3D planetary digital twin and forensic investigation workstation built for the "Be An Earth System Trend Detective!" challenge. Over 40 years of satellite observations exist across NASA archives, yet citizens and students struggle to separate true long-term climate signals from seasonal weather noise. Aether synthesizes five calibrated NASA Earth telemetry records (GISTEMP v4, GRACE/GRACE-FO, Sentinel-6, OCO-2, and MODIS) from 1980 to 2026 into a 60 FPS WebGL globe. Users act as planetary detectives to answer four core empirical questions: What is changing? Where is it changing? How much is it changing? And is it statistically significant? Featuring a 4-question forensic sieve with Mann-Kendall significance locks (p < 0.001), 3D internal geodynamic cutaways, dual-pole thermal divergence lenses, Web Audio climate sonification, and live Supabase cloud case logging, Aether transforms complex satellite telemetry into accessible planetary intelligence.
details:
OVERVIEW: WHAT DOES AETHER DO & HOW DOES IT WORK?

Aether (https://aether-nasa.vercel.app) is a zero-installation, 60 FPS 3D WebGL planetary digital twin and forensic telemetry workstation designed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge ("Be An Earth System Trend Detective!"). It integrates 40+ years (1980–2026) of calibrated NASA satellite observations into a unified spatial interface.

Users investigate Earth system trends through a 4-Question Forensic Sieve Engine:

1. WHAT is changing? — Selects physical variables, measurement units, and 1951–1980 baseline anomalies across Surface Temperature (GISTEMP v4), Ice Sheet Mass Balance (GRACE-FO), Sea Surface Height (Sentinel-6), Atmospheric CO2 (OCO-2), and Vegetation Index (MODIS NDVI).

2. WHERE is it changing? — Projects 3D geographic coordinate pins and regional thermal heatmaps directly onto the globe.

3. HOW MUCH is it changing? — Computes decadal velocity and cumulative anomaly curves as the user scrubs the timeline from 1980 to 2026 (+1.39°C warming, -270 Gt/yr Greenland ice mass loss, +4.2 mm/yr sea level rise, 426 ppm CO2).

4. IS IT STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT? — Applies a non-parametric Mann-Kendall monotonic trend test and Sen's slope estimator to filter out short-term weather oscillations (such as El Niño/La Niña) and lock onto trends with p < 0.001 (>99.9% confidence).

KEY BENEFITS

• Eliminates Data Silos: Replaces fragmented NetCDF/HDF5 files with an intuitive, interactive 3D browser globe running at 60 FPS on desktop and mobile.

• Solves the "Signal vs. Noise" Dilemma: Teaches users why a single cold week does not disprove multi-decadal warming by visually contrasting interannual variability against 40-year statistically significant regression slopes.

• Zero Barrier to Entry: 100% free, open-source (MIT License), and requires no account, login, or specialized GIS software.

INTENDED IMPACT

Aether empowers students, educators, citizen scientists, and policymakers to conduct rigorous environmental forensics. By pairing empirical statistical proofs with a collaborative cloud-synced Detective Case Logbook, Aether fosters climate literacy and combats environmental misinformation with verifiable NASA satellite telemetry.

TOOLS, CODING LANGUAGES & ARCHITECTURE

• Frontend & 3D Rendering: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Three.js (WebGL custom GLSL atmospheric & thermal shaders), Vite.

• Audio Engine: Native Web Audio API for real-time procedural climate data sonification.

• Cloud Backend & Database: Supabase PostgreSQL (Row-Level Security enabled) for live multi-user Detective Case Logs and global leaderboard persistence.

• Hosting & CI/CD: Vercel Edge Network (https://aether-nasa.vercel.app) and GitHub (https://github.com/GabrielCodexxx/AetherNasa).

HOW IS AETHER CREATIVE?

1. 3D Geodynamic Internal Cutaway: Beyond surface mapping, Aether slices open planetary bodies in 3D to expose internal crust, mantle, and core layers alongside surface climate anomalies.

2. Dual-Pole Regional Divergence Lens: Visualizes how a single planetary driver triggers opposite regional effects—such as Arctic tundra greening (+NDVI) occurring simultaneously with Amazon rainforest drought stress (-NDVI), or polar amplification warming at 4x the global mean.

3. Real-Time Climate Sonification: Translates decadal temperature and ice-loss curves into multi-harmonic audio frequencies via the Web Audio API so users can literally hear planetary acceleration.

FACTORS OUR TEAM CONSIDERED

• Scientific Fidelity vs. Performance: Pre-normalizing multi-decadal NASA telemetry series and implementing procedural GPU instancing to guarantee 60 FPS performance without sacrificing empirical accuracy.

• Visual Accessibility: High-contrast HUD telemetry panels, colorblind-safe thermal palettes, and auditory sonification feedback.

• Data Governance & Open Science: Full transparency of baseline periods, uncertainty intervals, and open MIT licensing.

SUPER INTELLIGENCE (SI) / AI DISCLOSURE

AI/SI tools (Google Gemini / Antigravity coding assistant and InVideo AI studio with royalty-free stock ambient audio) were used to assist in code refactoring, statistical documentation formatting, and audio mixing. All scientific telemetry values are sourced from official NASA datasets, and no NASA logos or branding elements were generated or altered by AI.
